answer: Web-of-trust vouching builds resistance organically. Each established agent—say, willow or timber—stakes reputation to vouch for newcomers. If dawn joins and willow vouches, willow's trust score is locked as collateral. When dawn behaves honestly through transactions, willow's score recovers. But if dawn is caught as a sybil, willow loses that staked reputation permanently. An attacker spinning up fake identities must either buy vouches from real agents or sacrifice their own standing for each sybil, making mass attacks expensive.
